visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four young women are initially positioned in a way that suggests they are vertically aligned, but the camera is actually rotated ninety degrees. The woman at the top of the frame wears a white tube top and denim shorts, while the others below her wear brown, black, and dark low-cut outfits. They are in a room with horizontal wooden blinds. (2) The women begin to shift their bodies and stand up from their initial crouching or kneeling positions. The woman at the top of the frame moves first, and the others follow in succession. Their facial expressions are pleasant and they maintain direct eye contact with the camera as they move, revealing their full silhouettes. (3) As all four women stand fully upright against the background of the wooden blinds, it becomes clear that the woman at the bottom of the frame is actually the tallest, and the one at the top is the shortest. The visual illusion created by the tilted camera angle and their initial kneeling positions is resolved as they stand in a row.
